n064ffe81073.s: Under the pre-2022 public-employment zonal grouping, Zone II comprised:
o: East Godavari, West Godavari and Krishna
n064ffe81073.x: Zone II comprised East Godavari, West Godavari and Krishna; Zone I was North Andhra, Zone III Guntur-Prakasam-Nellore and Zone IV Rayalaseema.

n0a1baf66992.s: Youth unemployment in Andhra Pradesh is reported as:
n0a1baf66992.x: Youth unemployment in Andhra Pradesh is reported as 17.5%, higher than the national rate.

o: Collective frustration among young people when social norms appear ineffective or harmful
Individual frustration of a young person over personal failure
Organised violence carried out only by youth wings of political parties
A temporary disagreement between students and teachers over examinations
n4c17039af77.x: Youth unrest is collective frustration among young people when society's norms seem ineffective or harmful.

nbbead4aca2b.s: The Anti-Arrack Movement in Andhra Pradesh was led by:
nbbead4aca2b.x: Dubagunta Rosamma led the Anti-Arrack Movement among neo-literate women of the literacy campaign.

n5514fa04d5a.s: The Anti-Arrack Movement of 1992 began in Dubagunta village of which district?
n5514fa04d5a.x: The movement began in 1992 in Dubagunta village of Nellore district, led by Dubagunta Rosamma.

n00d1c06a660.s: Article 47 directs the State to endeavour to prohibit, except for medicinal purposes, the consumption of:
o: Intoxicating drinks and drugs injurious to health
n00d1c06a660.x: Article 47, a Directive Principle, refers to prohibition of intoxicating drinks and drugs injurious to health, except for medicinal purposes.

n5fb7cee0389.s: India lies between which two major drug-producing regions?
n5fb7cee0389.x: India lies between the Golden Crescent and the Golden Triangle, two major drug-producing regions.

n7c7ca173661.s: Who propounded the concept of the “culture of poverty” in 1959?
n7c7ca173661.x: The concept of the “culture of poverty” was propounded by Oscar Lewis in 1959.

n1fea3a229a2.s: The Union opposes a creamy layer for SCs and STs mainly on the view that:
o: Caste exclusion exists only in urban areas
Economic criteria cannot be used in any welfare policy
Income alone does not end caste-based exclusion
n1fea3a229a2.x: The stated position is that income does not eliminate caste exclusion, so economic advancement alone does not end caste-based discrimination.

n5cd9fb90bcd.s: The Rangarajan poverty lines for 2011–12 were:
o: ₹32 per day urban and ₹47 per day rural
₹32 per day rural and ₹47 per day urban
₹47 per day in both rural and urban areas
₹27 per day rural and ₹33 per day urban
n5cd9fb90bcd.x: Rangarajan estimated ₹32 per day for rural and ₹47 per day for urban areas (₹972 and ₹1,407 per month).

nindian-society-11-13.s:
1. The S.R. Hashim Expert Group dealt with identifying urban BPL households.
2. The N.C. Saxena Expert Group dealt with the methodology of the rural BPL census.
3. The Rangarajan Committee on poverty measurement was chaired by Bimal Jalan.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-society-11-13.x: Hashim dealt with urban BPL identification and Saxena with the rural BPL census; statement 3 is wrong because C. Rangarajan chaired the 2012 committee.

n6389bd79d8c.s: The right to privacy is protected under which articles of the UDHR and the ICCPR respectively?
n6389bd79d8c.x: The UDHR protects privacy under Article 12 and the ICCPR under Article 17.

ndf2042fd018.s: India's position on the ICCPR and its First Optional Protocol is:
o: Not a party to the ICCPR at all
Party to the ICCPR since 1979 and signatory to the First Optional Protocol
Party to the ICCPR since 1979 but has not signed the First Optional Protocol
Party only to the Second Optional Protocol, not the ICCPR
ndf2042fd018.x: India has been a party to the ICCPR since 1979 but has not signed its First Optional Protocol, so its individual complaints procedure is unavailable.

n3b47a2ccea5.s: Which of the following pairs (right — recognition by the UN General Assembly) is correctly matched?
o: Right to a clean, healthy and sustainable environment — 1986
Right to water and sanitation — 28 July 2010
Right to water and sanitation — 28 July 2022
n3b47a2ccea5.x: The Right to Water and Sanitation was recognised on 28 July 2010; the Right to Development in 1986 and the Right to a Clean, Healthy and Sustainable Environment on 28 July 2022.

n4233d6bbcd8.s: In Karel Vasak's classification, the eradication of social discrimination falls under which generation of rights?
n4233d6bbcd8.x: Eradication of social discrimination is grouped with work, education and health as a second-generation (equality) right.

nindian-polity-2-7.s:
1. Article 14
2. Article 32
3. Article 40
Which of the above Articles deal with Fundamental Rights?
nindian-polity-2-7.x: Articles 14 and 32 are Fundamental Rights in Part III; Article 40 (village panchayats) is a Directive Principle in Part IV.

nindian-society-32-17.s:
1. Right to work
2. Right to education
3. Right to social security
Which of the above are economic and social rights in the UDHR?
nindian-society-32-17.x: Work, education and social security (along with health) are all economic and social rights in the UDHR.

n924c1f6202d.s: The Vishaka guidelines on workplace sexual harassment relied substantially on:
n924c1f6202d.x: In Vishaka (1997), the Supreme Court relied on CEDAW to frame workplace-harassment guidelines.

n796b083a612.s: In which 2003 case did PIL principles enable courts to rely on international conventions?
n796b083a612.x: The principles of public interest litigation enabled courts to rely on international conventions in Guruvayur Devaswom (2003).

ncb8ba62632c.s: The NCPCR, set up in 2007, works in line with which international instrument?
ncb8ba62632c.x: The NCPCR was set up in 2007 and works in line with the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child (UNCRC).

n34d18a7a9d7.s:
1. India remains outside the ICCPR individual-complaint mechanism.
2. NHRC advice is binding on the Government.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n34d18a7a9d7.x: India has not accepted the ICCPR First Optional Protocol complaint mechanism, and NHRC advice is non-binding, so only 1 is correct.

nindian-polity-27-6.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: NHRC members — appointed by the Prime Minister
NHRC selection committee — headed by the Chief Minister
SHRC selection committee — headed by the Prime Minister
SHRC members — appointed by the Governor
nindian-polity-27-6.x: The Governor appoints the SHRC; the President appoints the NHRC, the Prime Minister heads the NHRC selection panel and the Chief Minister the State one.

n0e1aabe57e2.s: Under the PHRA, 1993, 'human rights' are rights relating to life, liberty, equality and dignity that are:
o: Recognised only as civil and political rights in the UDHR
Guaranteed by the Constitution or embodied in International Covenants and enforceable by Indian courts
n0e1aabe57e2.x: The statutory definition covers rights relating to life, liberty, equality and dignity guaranteed by the Constitution or embodied in International Covenants and enforceable by Indian courts.

n0777190ee51.s: During an inquiry, the Human Rights Commission has the powers of a civil court under the CPC, 1908 for:
o: Awarding imprisonment to guilty public servants
Reviewing judgments of the High Courts
n0777190ee51.x: The Commission has civil-court powers such as summons, requiring documents, receiving affidavits and requisitioning public records; it has no sentencing powers.

n033e6bed586.s: Proceedings of a Human Rights Commission are deemed judicial proceedings for offences relating to:
o: Bribery and criminal breach of trust
False evidence and insulting a public servant in judicial proceedings
n033e6bed586.x: They are deemed judicial proceedings for false evidence (IPC 193) and insulting a public servant in judicial proceedings (IPC 228); corresponding BNS provisions apply from 1 July 2024.

n26d1af3c999.s: The Andhra Pradesh State Human Rights Commission is constituted by:
o: Parliament under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014
The Andhra Pradesh Government under the PHRA, 1993
n26d1af3c999.x: The AP SHRC is constituted by the Andhra Pradesh Government under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993.

n12689ccd3b3.s: Which of the following pairs (case — holding) is correctly matched?
o: Bachan Singh (1980) — 'Rarest of rare': life the rule, death the exception
Machhi Singh (1983) — Death penalty held constitutional
Bachan Singh (1980) — Categories of rarest cases
n12689ccd3b3.x: Bachan Singh (1980) laid down 'rarest of rare'; Jagmohan Singh (1973) upheld the death penalty and Machhi Singh (1983) set categories of rarest cases.

nd5df8ce4dff.s: A death sentence passed by a Sessions Court must be confirmed by the:
nd5df8ce4dff.x: A death sentence passed by a Sessions Court requires confirmation by the High Court.

n7f378be3cce.s: During 1999–2023, police-custody deaths and convictions reported were:
n7f378be3cce.x: The reported data recorded 2,253 police-custody deaths and only three convictions during 1999–2023.

n6349c3fca11.s: Under BNSS Section 479, an undertrial is generally eligible for release after serving what part of the maximum term?
n6349c3fca11.x: BNSS Section 479 provides release after one-half of the maximum term, reduced to one-third for first-time offenders, subject to statutory conditions.

na30aaf0ad6d.s: Which State records the highest number of deaths in police custody?
na30aaf0ad6d.x: Bihar records the most police-custody deaths, followed by Rajasthan and Uttar Pradesh.

nindian-society-40-31.s: The Constitution (106th Amendment) Act, 2023 is also known as:
nindian-society-40-31.x: The 106th Amendment Act, 2023 is the Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam, reserving one-third of seats in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies for women.

n11248816a64.s: Which of the following pairs (law — year) is correctly matched?
o: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act — 1994
n11248816a64.x: The Dowry Prohibition Act dates to 1961; ITPA is 1956, PCPNDT 1994 and the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act 2019.

nef40f515417.s: Which Act provides for monogamy and grounds of divorce under Hindu personal law?
nef40f515417.x: The Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 provides for monogamy and specifies grounds of divorce under Hindu personal law.

nindian-society-41-1.s: Which Act provides a civil, secular framework for marriage irrespective of caste, religion or faith, after public notice?
nindian-society-41-1.x: The Special Marriage Act, 1954 provides civil, secular marriage for anyone, whatever their caste, religion or faith, after a public notice.

nindian-society-48-10.s: Which of the following pairs (Act — year) is correctly matched?
nindian-society-48-10.x: The MTP Act dates from 1971; the Special Marriage Act is 1954, the Hindu Marriage Act 1955 and the Dowry Prohibition Act 1961.

nindian-society-48-14.s:
With reference to the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act:
1. It replaced the Sarda Act of 1929.
2. The minimum age is 18 years for females and 21 years for males.
3. It came into force on 1 November 2007.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-society-48-14.x: All three are correct: PCMA replaced the 1929 Sarda Act, sets ages at 18 and 21 (and makes child marriages voidable), and came into force on 1 November 2007.

nindian-society-1-18.s:
1. The National Commission for Women was established in 1992.
2. The first Equal Pay law was enacted in 1976.
3. The National Mission for Empowerment of Women was launched in 2015.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-society-1-18.x: The NCW (1992) and the Equal Remuneration Act (1976) are correct; the National Mission for Empowerment of Women began in 2010, not 2015.

n1c99a2ede97.s: The Haji Ali Dargah case decided by the Bombay High Court in 2016 concerned:
o: Women's exclusion from the inner sanctum
Maintenance of a divorced Muslim woman
Entry of women aged 10–50 into a temple
n1c99a2ede97.x: The case concerned the bar on women entering the inner sanctum of Haji Ali Dargah; entry was ultimately allowed.

nindian-society-27-10.s:
With reference to gender auditing:
1. It is a systematic evaluation of gender equality.
2. It covers policies, programmes, institutions and budgets.
3. It is restricted to budgets alone.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-society-27-10.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; statement 3 is false because a gender audit covers policies, programmes and institutions as well as budgets.

nindian-society-11-12.s:
1. J.S. Verma chaired the Justice Verma Committee.
2. The High-Level Committee on the Status of Women worked on women's empowerment.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-society-11-12.x: Both are correct: J.S. Verma chaired the Verma Committee, and the High-Level Committee on the Status of Women (Pam Rajput) worked on women's empowerment.

n944d368b142.s:
1. Gender mainstreaming was adopted as a strategy at Beijing.
2. A gender audit checks whether policies and budgets affect women and men equally.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n944d368b142.x: Gender mainstreaming builds a gender lens into every policy and was adopted as a Beijing strategy; a gender audit checks whether policies and budgets affect women and men equally.

n74216985ae2.s: The principal areas of work of the All India Women's Conference were:
o: Education, social upliftment and legal rights
n74216985ae2.x: The AIWC focused on education, social upliftment and legal rights.

n363e6322a36.s: The Gender Development Index compares females and males with respect to:
o: Health, education and command over resources
n363e6322a36.x: The GDI makes a female-to-male comparison in health, education and command over resources.

nindian-society-32-1.s: Gender mainstreaming was promoted globally at the World Conference on Women held in:
nindian-society-32-1.x: The Fourth World Conference on Women (Beijing, 1995) promoted gender mainstreaming globally.

nindian-society-32-8.s:
Gender mainstreaming aims to:
1. Reduce gender discrimination.
2. Ensure equitable development.
3. Promote inclusive governance.
Which of the above is/are correct?
nindian-society-32-8.x: Reducing discrimination, equitable development and inclusive governance (along with women's empowerment) are all aims of gender mainstreaming.

nf7424dff25b.s: Under Section 2(2), the Hindu Succession Act does not apply to:
o: Members of Scheduled Tribes, unless the Central Government directs otherwise
nf7424dff25b.x: Section 2(2) excludes notified Scheduled Tribes unless the Centre directs otherwise; the Supreme Court (8 Oct 2025) upheld this exclusion.

o: Criminalises prostitution itself in every circumstance
Only regulates registration of protective homes
Penalises brothel-keeping, soliciting and living on prostitution earnings, but not prostitution itself
na640ef89ba7.x: The ITPA does not criminalise prostitution itself; it penalises brothel-keeping, living on prostitution earnings, soliciting and detaining persons.

n13b4b7a5537.s: Section 3 of the Domestic Violence Act, 2005 covers which forms of abuse?
o: Physical, sexual and verbal or emotional abuse only
Physical, sexual, verbal or emotional, and economic abuse
Physical, verbal and economic abuse only
n13b4b7a5537.x: Section 3 covers physical, sexual, verbal or emotional, and economic abuse.

n803ed6fa97b.s: Under the Domestic Violence Act, 2005, which pair (relief — section) is correctly matched?
n803ed6fa97b.x: Residence orders are under Section 19; protection orders are under Section 18, monetary relief under Section 20 and compensation orders under Section 22.

n13947aea200.s: Under BNS Section 124, the punishment for an acid attack and for its attempt is respectively:
o: Maximum three years; seven to ten years
Minimum ten years to life; five to seven years
Minimum seven years to life; five to seven years
Minimum ten years to life; one year
n13947aea200.x: BNS Section 124 provides a minimum of ten years extending to life for acid attack, while attempt attracts five to seven years.

o: Prosecution and conviction of traffickers only
Prevention, rescue, rehabilitation and reintegration of trafficking victims
Overseas employment and migration of women
n628c7d7f484.x: Ujjawala covered prevention, rescue, rehabilitation and reintegration of trafficking victims.

n20271597423.s: A key reason for the continuing ineffectiveness of anti-dowry laws is:
o: Absence of any statutory prohibition of dowry
Excessive conviction rates in dowry cases
Poor enforcement, faulty FIRs and disguising cases as accidents or suicides
Exclusive jurisdiction of civil courts over dowry deaths
n20271597423.x: Poor enforcement, faulty FIRs and presenting dowry deaths as accidents or suicides are identified as major reasons for ineffectiveness.

n94b2dcb19ec.s: Which of the following pairs (crime head — NCRB classification) is correctly matched?
o: Cruelty by husband or relatives — Special and Local Law
Kidnapping and abduction of women — Special and Local Law
Protection of women from domestic violence — IPC/BNS head
Indecent representation of women — Special and Local Law
n94b2dcb19ec.x: Indecent representation and domestic violence (PWDVA) are SLL heads; cruelty by husband and kidnapping/abduction are IPC/BNS heads.

n8d853ac364b.s:
Honour killings violate which of the following Articles?
1. Article 14
2. Article 19
3. Article 21
Which of the above is/are correct?
n8d853ac364b.x: Honour killings violate Articles 14, 15, 19 and 21, protecting equality, freedoms and life and personal liberty.

nac07a1389a3.s:
Which of the following are funded by the Nirbhaya Fund?
1. One Stop Centres
2. Women Helpline 181
3. ERSS 112
Which of the above is/are correct?
nac07a1389a3.x: One Stop Centres, Women Helpline 181 and ERSS 112 are all funded by the Nirbhaya Fund.

n819d2f21b62.s:
The Trishul committees in Andhra Pradesh pursue:
1. Zero drugs
2. Zero tolerance to atrocities against women
3. Zero road accidents
Which of the above is/are correct?
n819d2f21b62.x: Trishul committees are state and district panels pursuing zero drugs, zero tolerance to atrocities against women and zero road accidents.

o: Prenatal tests for detecting genetic abnormalities
Collection of census data on sex ratio
n2f71d324e54.x: The PCPNDT law bans advertising sex determination, while it permits diagnostic procedures for genetic abnormalities.

nfbed6b5e5ad.s: The Juvenile Justice Act, 2015 permits 16–18-year-olds to be tried as adults for:
nfbed6b5e5ad.x: The JJ Act, 2015 permits 16–18-year-olds to be tried as adults for heinous crimes, subject to the statutory process.

n11f09f8310e.s: The Law Commission's 242nd Report (2012) proposed a draft law concerning:
o: Interference in matrimonial alliances in the name of honour
n11f09f8310e.x: The 242nd Report proposed a draft law against interference in matrimonial alliances in the name of honour.

o: State-level relief homes for trafficked women under Mission Shakti
District-level task forces funded by MHA for trafficking intelligence, rescue and prosecution
Central units of I4C issuing cyber-trafficking alerts
Special courts for trafficking trials in each district
na55a2bf66c0.x: AHTUs are district-level task forces funded by the Ministry of Home Affairs for trafficking intelligence, rescue and prosecution.

n13225f9d492.s:
With reference to Mission Shakti:
1. Sambal includes One Stop Centres, Women Helpline 181 and Nari Adalat.
2. Samarthya includes Shakti Sadan and PMMVY.
3. Sambal is the empowerment component, whereas Samarthya is the safety component.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
n13225f9d492.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct; statement 3 reverses the roles, since Sambal is the safety component and Samarthya the empowerment component.

n140c2c59866.s: Under the POCSO Act, which court may be designated as the Special Court in each district?
o: Court of the Chief Judicial Magistrate
n140c2c59866.x: The POCSO Act permits a Sessions Court to be designated as the Special Court in each district.

nindian-polity-76-10.s: Which of the following pairs (body — Article on women's reservation) is correctly matched?
nindian-polity-76-10.x: Article 330A covers the Lok Sabha; 243D covers Panchayats, 243T Municipalities and 332A State Assemblies.

nindian-polity-76-26.s:
1. Women's reservation in the NCT of Delhi Assembly covers directly elected seats as well as SC-reserved seats.
2. The NCT of Delhi Assembly is covered by Article 332A.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-polity-76-26.x: Statement 1 is true (Delhi has no ST reservation); statement 2 is false because Delhi comes under Article 239AA(2)(ba), not 332A.

n594f8a1306d.s: Women's reservation under the 106th Amendment will commence after delimitation based on the:
n594f8a1306d.x: The reservation commences only after delimitation based on the first Census after the Act, i.e. the 2027 Census.

n3dcb9e3900f.s: The reservation for women under the 106th Amendment is provided for:
n3dcb9e3900f.x: The reservation is provided for 15 years and may be extended by Parliament.

n6e2b34bd726.s: The principal legal shield against atrocities and discrimination targeting Dalit and tribal communities is:
o: SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993
Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955 and Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976
SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955
Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993 and Bonded Labour System (Abolition) Act, 1976
n6e2b34bd726.x: The safeguards identified are the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 and the Protection of Civil Rights Act, 1955.

nindian-polity-76-41.s:
With reference to seats reserved for SCs and STs:
1. The mandatory sub-quota for SC/ST women within these seats is one-third.
2. The mandatory sub-quota for SC/ST women within these seats is 50%.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-polity-76-41.x: Within SC/ST reserved seats, one-third must go to SC/ST women, not 50%.

n77479c51ecf.s: What percentage of seats is reserved for women in Andhra Pradesh local bodies?
n77479c51ecf.x: Andhra Pradesh provides 50 per cent reservation for women in local bodies.

nindian-polity-76-15.s:
1. The constitutional baseline for women's reservation in Panchayats is one-third.
2. Bihar was the first State to grant 50% reservation for women in Panchayats, in 2006.
Which of the above statement(s) is/are correct?
nindian-polity-76-15.x: Both are true: the constitutional minimum is one-third, and Bihar first raised it to 50% in 2006.
